all_reviews.author: Bilal Mohsin
all_reviews.text: I've got to say, the Remini app is a total game-changer! It's an AI-powered photo editing tool that can take your low-quality photos and turn them into stunning, high-definition images. I've seen it work its magic on old, blurry photos, and the results are nothing short of amazing ¹. One of the standout features of Remini is its ability to enhance faces in photos. It can take a blurry, low-resolution image and turn it into a sharp, detailed portrait.

all_reviews.text: WTH?! So, been paying for this app for more than a year, and it is just they clearly don't have it together, changes they make cause problems. I have a yellow warning box at the top "we're experiencing unusually high traffic" and it doesn't work at all for me! I find it ridiculous for what you all charge for this app to ever have these type of issues! How about fix it, or refund me all these months that it has been working sub-par at best!

all_reviews.author: michael peck
all_reviews.text: I couldn't do anything at all without paying. Was never offered a free trial at all. The only available options were $2.99/week, $9.99/week, & "Restore Purchases." Just to see what would would happen, I hit "Restore Purchases" and it said that there were no purchases to restore. Both options for $2.99 and $9.99 were trying to charge me right out immediately. I would like a chance to try it to see if I will like it before paying for it. App data and cache cleared from phone and uninstalled.

all_reviews.author: Ms. Ellis
all_reviews.text: This app is decent but it requires some improvements. Some pictures add too many arms or a piece of an arm or hand is added. Sometimes the arms or legs are too long for the body size. The hair feature mixes up the styles/textures or a portion of the hair hangs off. It would be nice to incorporate a few different heights and physical body types. The ai facial features are spot on at times. I would give it a higher star rating if it would fix the disfigured creature features.

all_reviews.author: Tom Purnell
all_reviews.text: the ads are out of freaking control. had to watch the video twice and sit there for over a minute before a little x finally popped up too close the add... and that was just to get to the flipping home screen!!! I go to edit a pic and now I have to watch another ad! Bruh, I sure as hell am not going to pay for your app if I can't even play around with it first.

all_reviews.author: karen ainley
all_reviews.text: I used to use Remini to add a fun mix into my art , I was able to use a pic with a Face and I would be able to get Animation of the Person moving their face !! It was so cool . I can not seem to find this now ( I have recently done a update on my phone and since then it's just Photo' ' Regenerating photos ' ?? Remini , do you not have this feature any more ????

all_reviews.author: Rasha Abdel Kareem
all_reviews.text: It's too slow, and there are too many ads that stay playing too long for every single click. I know it is meant to be that for the free ones, but not that way. Also, the photos get worse after enhancements. The older version was much better, plus it enabled you to choose which enhancing option to be kept for the photo and which should not be kept. Unfortunately, I will not use this app again.

all_reviews.author: Milkshaketurtle79
all_reviews.text: The app does what it says it does, and it does it VERY well. It's actually pretty shocking. But the ads are absolutely inexcusable. I could understand an ad maybe every few times you do something. Or pop up ads you can just close. But it forces you to watch a long, 30 second ad for everything. I mean a 30 second ad for enhancing it, a 30 second ad for removing the watermark, and a 30 second ad to save it. You need to watch 1:30 of ads to enhance a picture.

all_reviews.author: Mick Bird
all_reviews.text: I know it needs paying for, but sadly, every little thing you want to do, you have to watch an ad. On the whole, it is very good at animating still photos, but the novelty soon wears off, and most phones do this anyway. And to top it off, another ad to save any altered pics.The other effects available are also available in the phone photo gallery, so nothing out of the ordinary. Unnecessary phone storage, uninstalling.

all_reviews.author: C. Cooper
all_reviews.text: I'd be lying if i said this app wasn't cool...But, It takes a long time to generate, which is not a problem, I should be able to cancel the generator or at least be asked if I'm sure I want to generate the picture, once you generate you have to wait the time it gives you which can be 5-10 minutes or more. Over all, it generates very accurate and well, it can sometimes give you three arms and 6 legs lol, It's a really fun app. It just has a few things that could be fix.

all_reviews.author: Colby Wiggin
all_reviews.text: Sorry but this app has become unusable. When I first for it, I was able to go on, and watch 1 or 2 apps so I can "advance" a photo and then save it (yes, I'd have to watch another ad to save the photo). But now, all I do is click the screen on the app, and an ad pops up. I've spent 10 minutes alone, just trying to advance ONE photo and thats because I had to watch ad after ad after ad. No longer a 4 star, but a 1 star.

all_reviews.author: Rimesh Patel
all_reviews.text: I'd give this 0 stars if possible. The app used to be great with multiple features. If used subtly, it produced great results. There's so many great free mobile apps out there, I rarely buy any...until i found this. HOWEVER, a few days after I bought an annual subscription, the company removed all but 2 features. I'm not sure if they changed something on their back end, but new results are far worse than before. Emails to CS go unanswered. I'm just hoping Google refunds my purchase.

all_reviews.author: Dion Hughes
all_reviews.text: I am officially fed up! I don't mind the ads. What I do mind is nothing but ads, going back and forth on the pages of the ads and then instead of being able to enhance my photo I get kicked out of the app, then Remini holds my phone hostage and gives me more ads even though I'm no longer in the app. I have to turn my phone off and on to get rid of the ads. Just wasted 20 minutes of my time and accomplished nothing! I used to love this app. Please fix or I'm uninstalling it!

all_reviews.author: Dre Day
all_reviews.text: Was great not anymore. You need to now pay for every option. There are free options but are now very limited. And they are not free. You must watch a ad when app opens. When you select a option. When you want to change. And when you want to save. Plus the ads are scam. Cause the exit buttons leads to play store. You need to attempt to press several times. Flipping back and forth from this app and play store to actually exit. This app was the greatest. Now is very very bad.

all_reviews.author: Naomi S
all_reviews.text: Edit: I went to cancel and the language on the cancel subscription screen is VERY misleading and I have picture and video. That took my rating from a 4 to a 1. Remove that ASAP! You shouldn't have to trick people into paying for your app! After hitting "cancel subscription" a screen pops up that offers a paid version or an option to "go back to limited" and there is a "continue" button. I hit continue to complete the cancelation and instead it locked me in to pay for a week THEN cancel!

all_reviews.author: Brandon Collins
all_reviews.text: 3 ads within seconds of each other to process, finish processing, and then save to device? Absolutely ridiculous. I understand they want to make money, and it appeared that this product would be something I would subscribe to, but after showing a complete lack of regard toward the end user in their pursuit of the almighty dollar, I think I'll skip this one. There's plenty of other apps out there that won't try to monetize every single second of usage like Remini does. Greed. Pure and simple.

all_reviews.author: Ashley G
all_reviews.text: Best photo enhancer ever!!! It's easy to use and significantly enhances low quality photos to look high quality! No other apps, I've seen can do it as well as this app! I 100% recommend. The only possible problem (If you despise ads) is that to get your photo enhanced, you have to watch an ad. I don't mind it at all though! Also you can only do 5 photos a day, but it replenishes itself the next day. I don't have an issue with it though since I only do a few a day anyway.

all_reviews.author: Vanessa Ekhaese
all_reviews.text: I think I've been scammed. The app is great and all but when you sign up for the 7 days free trial, they debit your account instantly. That's not how other apps do. Normally with other apps, they allow the free trial period to expire before they charge you. I'm so disappointed and regardless of how great the app is, I can't get past this deception. Uninstalling right away.

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: Works wonders on blurry photos, BUT the app itself is buggy and constantly crashing. I basically can't select photos from other albums to edit because as soon as I try to select from anything but my main photo album, the app crashes. I tried redownloading it to see if it would fix the issue, but no success. This would be a 5-star app if I could open and edit photos from other albums, but until the app can handle it without crashing it's 2-stars at best. Please fix!!

all_reviews.author: CDR
all_reviews.text: Used to be great, now it's terrible. Half the time the image doesn't upload, the other half it won't save when you're done. Ah but don't worry, the ads always work, and it's always the longest 30 secs + 15 secs ads, and because the image won't upload or save you have to try against and that means watching yet another ad. Good job, you had an amazing app and you broke it, but I understand, it's not a bug, it's a feature 🙃

all_reviews.author: Goldfish
all_reviews.text: Terrible for anything that is not a face, such as text. Tries to push you into paying immediately, without even knowing if it works, and then has ads for everything. Didnt bother trying with other photographs because of the constant ads. Dont bother with it. I didnt sign up for a subscription or the free trial, i had better not be charged for a subscription.

all_reviews.author: Kat
all_reviews.text: This app is very limited. It only half works if the images aren't too blurred. If you're trying to clear an image really distorted, this isn't the app. Also, it only clears the face, not capable of full picture scans. The last thing, if it does clear the image, chances are high that it'll distort the image more and the faces will end up looking worse. Do not recommend.

all_reviews.author: Sabrina Dawn
all_reviews.text: Used to be a great app, also used to be 4.99 a month, what is this 2.99 a week now? I cancelled just because of that, but be aware, you have to watch an ad (30 seconds or longer) for to enhance the photo, then watching an ad if you don't want the watermark to be huge on the photo, AND watching an ad just to download the photo. Not sure what was going on, but I'm deleting this app and finding another this is ridiculous .

all_reviews.author: Barbie L
all_reviews.text: This used to be so great. Now it doesn't even work. On the rare occasion you don't get the "oops something went wrong" error....you have to watch an ad for even one photo. They used to give you 3 I think? Could be wrong but I know you could use it at least once before they made you watch ads. Craziness. All any one seems to care about is money any more. I am not going to pay for a product I can't even use so....Uninstalled.

all_reviews.author: Senan Gill
all_reviews.text: Very powerful editing features, but it's ruined by ads which make it asically impossible to do anything. It would be fine if it was just one or two because sure, ad revenue, but in the space of editing one photo I got four ads, some of which were a minute long. I'd rather download a different app which doesn't make me want to rip my hair out 🤷‍♀️

all_reviews.author: Dre
all_reviews.text: Can't use it. After downloading, it's installed, click get started, next screen is enhance with the option to hit next or skip, click either one & it says network timeout. I tried it on 2 different devices, that are 2 different brand phones, wifi then cellular network & still doesn't work. AI Photo Enhance/Unblur works! It just has ads & you're limited to how many free pics you can do a day. This app, smh. Can't even say it's a waste of time because I didn't get to use it

all_reviews.author: Peter Istrate
all_reviews.text: Waste of time. I installed the app in the hope that I could try a few features to see how my images look (at least as a preview, not having to save the images). But you can't do anything without paying for a pro plan, you can't even see a preview. And, I might as well pay for a pro plan, but I don't know what I'm getting (I've seen so many apps scamming you about what they can offer, and after you pay, you realise the app is nothing as advertised). You just have to take their word.

all_reviews.author: Wixin Jiji
all_reviews.text: To be honest, when the first version of Remini came, i liked it more. It didn't focus on making your skin super white or remove your smile wrinkles etc. It simply enhances the quality of the picture. That's what we all came for, TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF OUR PHOTOS!! The ads is also a turn off in this app, this app so much potential since it's only purpose is to enhance the quality of our photos, but no, it provided some other parts in it that's super irrelevant.

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: Requires you to enter an email before you can use the app at all. I do not like this. This is not an app you can buy and use. You have to buy 'cards' that you use for each image, about $1.00 an image. You get 3 free 'credits' per day. When you select an image it puts you in a virtual 'cue' and you have to wait a minute+ to even see if the image is fixed in an acceptable way. If it isn't, tough luck, you have already spent your credit on it. Cost too much to have fun with or get much use out of.

all_reviews.author: Mary LeRoy
all_reviews.text: A long ad after every single task!!! Never have seen an app this bad. Not even good results. I tried 3 different photos to give it a fair shot. Very disappointing. Update! I went to the paid version and was happy with it. Did a beautiful job on every photo for awhile. Now there is no difference between the old photo and the enhanced version. Reinstalled and still no difference.

all_reviews.author: CB
all_reviews.text: It keeps saying "oops something went wrong. Please check your internet connection and try again later". I tried it with both my data and wifi on. I tried it with 1 on and the other off. But it continues to say that after making me watch an ad. Wasting my time making me watch ads, yet won't do anything with my photos. Restarting my phone didn't make a difference either so it's the app, not my phone. Pictures aren't always accurate so don't waste your time on this app.

all_reviews.author: Yaren NTekngndz
all_reviews.text: I wish I could give 0 stars. To people who installed it for the 'LinkedIn' profile photo generated by AI, don't. Unless you can pay. It doesn't even allow you once. Also I tried to generate it while I was on a call, and it didn't work, I waited a lot. Then when my call ended, I restarted the app and it worked at last, only to come accross payment page whenever i clicked continue and when i closed the payment page it kept showing ads. Like, if you play ads, at least let me use the AI for ONCE.

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: I'm very impressed with the technology however it feels like a complete waste. The servers are incredibly slow, I pay for the subscription which gets me infinite photos for the day but the queue time they claim you save is a complete lie. It's the same queue as it still takes just as long. Also their video service they provide is a waste of time. They claim it takes UP TO 48 hours but my video has been going for 50 now. I'm on a bit of time crunch and I don't even know if it's going to work

all_reviews.author: Anika Patel
all_reviews.text: WAY. TOO. MANY. ADS. I have purchased annual subscriptions previously, but won't be again at the ridiculous new prices they are now charging - for a reduced quality/service. The free version is an absolute nuisance with an ad for every single option/button selected. It's actually not worth your time or the results to put up with it. I definitely DO NOT recommend it!!

all_reviews.author: Hermione Lee
all_reviews.text: Ive had this app since 2019. Back then, the app was much more simpler, lesser features compared to the current one but most importantly NO ADS. Right now, I open the app and the first thing I see is 2 unskipable ads. I want to change the background colors, ad again and if I want to export the picture, another ad. Gosh, its everywhere and right in my face. I can understand getting an ad when I want to export my pictures but getting 1-2 ads after every single interaction is atrocious

all_reviews.author: Ashley David
all_reviews.text: I've been an avid user of Remini since 2019. However, as the app upgrades, I noticed that: 1. it keeps on saying that something went wrong whenever I try to enhance a photo. I've seen other reviews regarding this matter, too; 2. it displays a lot of ads. I understand that the app progresses, but it would be much better if ads are minimized (like not right every after click on the app); and 3. the older version was much better than the new one.

all_reviews.author: Rinna Mae Tobias
all_reviews.text: I really liked this before because you just have to watch 1 ad before enhancing and 1 ad to save the photo. Now, when you are going to save the photo you'll eventually have to watch more ads than expected and the worst part? it lasts for more than a minute. I'm not gonna wait up to that long and end up with a bunch more ads and even couldn't save the photo. this app is totally a scam. and maybe I'll uninstall it later on.

all_reviews.author: George Labanick
all_reviews.text: I last used this app one year ago and paid for a 3 month subscription. I loved that version, and the cost was worth the money for the features. I dropped the subscription as I finished enhancing a group of old pictures. This year, I got another batch of photos to enhance and colorize and paid for another 3 month subscription. What a waste of money, as all but two features are gone! My rating dropped from 5 stars a year ago to 1 star now.

all_reviews.author: J.
all_reviews.text: The enhance looked way better before you updated the UI and changed the way it's processed somehow. There are so many more artifacts, a grid, repeated pattern on skin and hair, less pixels and less sharpness and more weirdness in the new photos. I hate it. I was using the old version until you stopped me from being able to. UPDATE: Now I have upgraded and once again it is terrible. I paid for a subscription for a few months, definitely won't be doing that again unless you fix the processing.

all_reviews.author: Pijush Bauri
all_reviews.text: I've got to say, the Remini app is a total game-changer! It's an Al-powered photo editing tool that can take your low-quality photos and turn them into stunning, high-definition images. I've seen it work its magic on old, blurry photos, and the results are nothing short of amazing. One of the standout features of Remini is its ability to enhance faces in photos. It can take a blurry, low-resolution image and turn it into a sharp, detailed portrait.

all_reviews.author: Raeshaz71
all_reviews.text: Very Disappointed!! This was a great app, which I subscribed to, but all of the extras that I'm paying for have disappeared!!! I used the portrait, remove scratch & video enhancers frequently along with the general photo enhancer & plus; now I'll need to look for another app that does these & cancel my Remini subscription. The irony is, just as I opened the app, I was asked to do a questionnaire about how happy I was with the video enhancer, to which I replied ~ very happy!! Obviously not now!

all_reviews.author: JuLiuSSY YT
all_reviews.text: I tried using the Remini app, and oh girl, let me tell you, it's a complete disaster! It's a waste of phone storage and time!! I wouldn't even give it a single star. I've been stuck with this app for about two years now, and the updates? Don't even get me started! They've ruined it completely. Ads, ads, and more ads! It's like you can't even breathe without another ad popping up. And the pictures? It's far from the original!

all_reviews.author: angelglyph
all_reviews.text: Honestly, this is the app I was looking for ever since I started making small edits for profile pictures and backgrounds. I always find pictures on google that I want to use for an edit, but it's always bad quality. Now that I have the photo enhancer, it makes it a whole lot easier. Plus, it's free and the ads aren't even that long. You could pay for the photo enhancer+ to get better quality, but I'm satisfied enough with the regular one. Anyways, this is a great app, and I highly recommend it!

all_reviews.author: Earl Bronaugh
all_reviews.text: Same as previous reviews, loved app in 2021. Added the 29.95 subscription for the year in 2022, then app features went to subparr, lost all my advance credits and additional features. I sent in a subscription cancel request. Maybe the loss of clients will bring things back the way it was. And yes, the emails sent to them have no response, waist of time. Cancel your subscription, delete the app And find something similar, there are a lot more players in the game

all_reviews.author: Stephanie Denson
all_reviews.text: They overwhelme you with ads! EVERY time to tap something, you are prompted to pay the subscription, if you say no, ad! You want to go into a filter, ad. Choosing your photo once inside, ad. After ad is done, it sends you back to starting page WITHOUT giving you your edited photo. Then start over back at square one. You'll be 9 ads in and still not have a single edited photo. I'm all for watching ads, but this is just too much.

all_reviews.author: Lopa Mitra
all_reviews.text: Their editing is good. But there are too many adds , sometime there are two add in a row and you can't skip eat so you have to watch one minute, and if you want to save your photo then you have to watch add one more time. So irritating, actually they want to frustrated you, and day one that you will buy their subscription. Is not possible to buy a subscription. For free users like us, day by day this app is becoming more and more irritating.

all_reviews.author: Yulia De La Mora
all_reviews.text: This app duplicately charged me for 10 pay periods. Two charges in one week. $55 overcharge. When I reached out to support, they said I purchased the app. Yes, I did, but I'm supposed to be charged $4.99 per week, not double!! They never refunded overcharges. Then they offered a cheaper option of $2.19 per week, when I wanted to cancel. I accepted. One month in, they brought adds. Six adds per enhanced picture for $9 a month! Greedy. It is also very complicated to cancel this app. Disappointment

all_reviews.author: Fionna Grant
all_reviews.text: Overcharged. The subscription fee is advertised as $5 per month. I have been charged $4.59NZ 8 times (once a week), for a total of $36.72 NZ for the period 31/05/22 - 19/07/22. The charges also appear with a different company name making it more difficult to work out what is going on. Very much a second rate app also as the images that are "enhanced" just look strange. I feel like I have been conned. Very upsetting experience.

all_reviews.author: Joey Summer
all_reviews.text: Great app, but you need to work on the teeth in portrait, because while everything else is perfect the teeth is botched-up and unrealistic in most instances. Sometimes it's too much of a baby face as well. The skin should be clean, but not too much filter and skin lightening, so I think there should be an adjustment slider for levels of preferences to suit the users.

all_reviews.author: Matt and Lou Lancaster
all_reviews.text: I might be missing something as I've heard lots of people rave about this app, but I don't think it enhanced the photos enough to warrant the ridiculous amount of time watching stupid ads!.. I have lots of photo editing apps, many that do a better job than this, without all the ads, and without a 5 photo limit. I uninstalled the app 10 minutes after downloading it! This ones not for me I'm afraid!

all_reviews.author: Aman Dosanjh
all_reviews.text: The app is honestly amazing when it comes to enhancing photos. The clarity and colors improve a lot, and the final result looks great. But the amount of ads is just too much! There's an ad when you open the app, another when you choose a photo, then again while it's enhancing, and even more ads when you try to save the photo. It’s extremely frustrating and ruins the whole experience. Please fix this...it feels like watching ads is more important than editing photos!

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: Actually a very good app, except for two problems: 1: Only ad-supported or subscription-based, cannot buy it outright. 2: If you use it too many times for free, the app tells you "no more ads, try again later" and straight up refuses to let you enhance more photos, which is absolute garbage. The company behind it needs to seriously rethink their business model before I can recommend this app to professionals. It "only" costs $5 a month to subscribe. However, I use apps like this a lot for editing and I'd rather not subscribe, but they don't give me any choice. Look for a freeware knockoff if you can.

all_reviews.author: Heike Barker
all_reviews.text: I used to love remini. Now they have taken all my pro cards - which I had paid for! Try to install it on my computer and had to sign up for a free trial with cc info. I have paid until the end of the month!! It also said it will cost $ 4.99 per WEEK now!! Will cancel my subscription today! P.S. I almost thought about subscribing again until I read through at least 50 reviews and all the standart apologies from remini. If you ever go back to the original version I would subscribe again.

all_reviews.author: Maksim Jovovic
all_reviews.text: I'm sure it's a great app, heard great things about it, but for me right now it's useless. Constantly shows error related to Internet connection even though I'm connected to the Internet. Tried it on 2 different phones, doesn't work on either one. Sent them an email, no response. Googled the error and saw tons of people having the same issue.

all_reviews.author: Ariel
all_reviews.text: Remini has doubled how many times they are charging for my account, as if my account has two subscriptions for the same service. There were 7 "weekly" charges in March. There's no contact for them here my. I cancelled "both" of my accounts! It was a fun program, but double dipping into my finances is not copesetic. It would probably be easy enough to sort out with a quick dialogue, but there's no contact listed. Your mileage may vary.

all_reviews.author: Cherry Wagenblast
all_reviews.text: The app is good...when it actually works. I cant get pro but I don't mind watching short ads while a wait to get the finished product. The problem is tho, is that it'll make me watch an ad but when the ad is over, there will be no x button to leave. I could sit there all day and the ad will be stuck on my screen w/o me being able to exit. So I click the back button but it'll just say that I have to watch the entire ad to proceed, even tho I did. Usually have to delete and re-download

all_reviews.author: Zelle Anne A. Oroyan
all_reviews.text: it's a great app for clearing up the blue photo into a clear one. But the reason why I gave it 2 stars is because although it can enhance the photo, when pressing one picture of your choice to enhance it plays an ad even though I hadn't pressed the enhance button yet. It's annoying how I have to watch 2 ad just for one picture that I want to enhance. Even if you enhance at least 1-3 pictures, you still have to watch an ad to enhance the picture. I hope you can minimize the ads.

all_reviews.author: Steven McKinney
all_reviews.text: I have a paid subscription for unlimited enhancements. I enhanced maybe 40 images, and now I see the error "Users.rate_limited". This error comes because the "unlimited" plan is actually limited. All you're getting is for the monthly subscription is ad free. Bait and switch, 100%. Now they hit you with 90 second ads that are unskippable. The app will allow you to watch an ad as if you'll get the cleaned up photo, only to tell you after the 90 second ad that your rate is limited.

all_reviews.author: Nastaran
all_reviews.text: I would give 0 star if I could. I installed the app, used it but didn't enjoy the experience for many reasons, however the worst part was realizing how annoying and complicated it actually is to just unsubscribe and delete your account with Remini. The worst part is after emailing them per their shady instruction for removing the account, I never heard back or recieved any type of confirmation that my request has been processed or is in progress. The whole thing is quite unprofessional.

all_reviews.author: Brian Abbott
all_reviews.text: Following my previous comments below some months ago, this app has gone downhill. It is plagued with intrusive ads, and it's a pain to use. An otherwise brilliant app spoilt. DON'T INSTALL IT, YOU'LL REGRET IT. Old Review (5 stars): Absolutely amazing. I took a photo of a twenty odd year old blurred photo and enhanced it with Remini and it looked perfectly in focus. I can't say how impressed I am.

all_reviews.author: JUGAL, Shalom Princess D.
all_reviews.text: Hello, I've been using this for more than a year and it was astonishing!... I really like this app. However, the latest update is crashing a lot. • Sometimes, it says that there is no internet connection when I press enhance. • Sometimes, it would play an ad, but after playing it... a pop up will show that there is no internet connection, try again later. • It only worked once(1) out of 10 tries... The old version is better...

all_reviews.author: Kenny Wiratrijaka
all_reviews.text: The latest version is really annoying and unnecessary. The interface is confusing and i can't see the enhanced photos i did before. Not to mention now you only have 5x photo enhancing instead of 10x. You also can't enhance the 2nd time bcs its not "pro". And saving pictures need a full ad too??? It's getting out of hand, You guys clearly milking every ounce of profit out of this, it shows and it's stupid. Bring the old version back!

all_reviews.author: Brendan Richmond
all_reviews.text: Bring back the old algorithm. I don't know what you changed, or why, but the image quality is noticably worse in the recent weeks. I used to be blown away by the upscaling and loved processing old photos through it, but now it looks like a bad painterly filter. Also, why so much tweaking of white balance and colors? That's not your job and nobody asked you to. I'm hoping you change for the better, but as it is, the way this app has changed means it's no longer worth the effort.

all_reviews.author: C MH

all_reviews.text: App seemed to convinced me from an ad point of view but the con is to pay for enhancing and editing with tax along with having your own account and ads. Plus it 40+ megabits to download. I regret downloading this app. There are other apps that are better than this and you can edit without purchasing anything. It's like TV food (It may look good by the pic but it's not when you're trying think it is). Also other comments are similar to this. If you're were rich, you can purchase it.

all_reviews.author: Hitokiri R.S
all_reviews.text: I had given it 5☆ years ago, when the app was at its peak. A couple of ads, and it was done. Now sad to say that the number of ads added to edit 1 picture is insane. Up to 5 minutes plus to edit 1 picture, which quality was decreased too. Once the ads start, they don't want to let go. You added too many ads for each edit and ruined this app. The juice is not worth the squeeze.

all_reviews.author: j5s9c
all_reviews.text: It does work very well on some photos, yet on others there is no noticeable difference. I find it annoying that you can only use it 5 times a day! I would've thought that having to watch an add every enhance and save was sufficient. Might buy the pro version if it's a one-off payment, but not weekly. Jury is out at the moment.

all_reviews.author: Niox White
all_reviews.text: In the past, when we used to use Remini to edit our photos, just one ad before editing and one ad after editing would appear, and it was good. However, nowadays, we have to watch five or more ads before and after editing, and some of those ads are even one minute long. This has really made me stop using Remini. Just because we are free users doesn't mean we have unlimited time. You have to think about your users' satisfaction as well, not just your own. One ad before and after was acceptable.

all_reviews.author: Cosmin Gurau
all_reviews.text: This app used to just AI-upscale, and was amazing for faces, the best version of GFP-GAN I have ever seen. But now it destroys the photos because it changes the colors, contrast and exposure as well, with NO option to turn that part of the processing OFF. This needs to be an option, preferably with a slider for intensity. The way it is right now, you need to use Photoshop with the original photo as a top layer set to COLOR blend mode to correct the absolutely egregious oversaturation.

all_reviews.author: FrostyFireBoi
all_reviews.text: This is one of the best editors out there because it actually enhances your picutre and videos for free!!! You only have to watch an ad before the enhance and after downloading the picture or video it which is totally fair. This is a must use app. The only thing I need them to add is if we could select couple of pictures and then they can enhance them all one after another.

all_reviews.author: Erhan Destan
all_reviews.text: Absolutely Brilliant! Well done to the developers, hats off... I'm doing a professional catalogue for our cosmetics company. I had a few blurred out images from the manufacturers. After a search a came across Remini. And the results are stunning. The only thing that I'm gutted about is that had I had know about this app, I would have used it earlier.

all_reviews.author: Harold Timson
all_reviews.text: Garbage app that even fake blurs for a "before/after" slider. Want your own proof, run a picture through it. Of which, be prepared to watch an ad to upload a pic and then another ad to save the actual results. Anyways, took this picture with it's garbage "enhancements" and ran it through the app again. It blurred the before picture claiming this was what I started with. Joke was on them, I used their enhanced photo.

all_reviews.author: R-11 Fahad
all_reviews.text: I am FUMING about the ridiculous number of ads in this app! 🤯 It's like they want me to see ads more than the actual content! 📺 I downloaded this app thinking it would be a useful tool, but it's turned into an ad-filled nightmare! 😩 Every. Single. Time. I open the app, I'm bombarded with ads. And not just any ads, but LOUD, JUMPING-OUT-OF-THE-SCREEN ads that make me want to throw my phone out the window!

all_reviews.author: Nd Thakur
all_reviews.text: I've got to say, the Remini app is a total game-changer! It's an Al-powered photo editing tool that can take your low-quality photos and turn them into stunning, high-definition images. I've seen it work its magic on old, blurry photos, and the results are nothing short of amazing'. One of the standout features of Remini is its ability to enhance faces in photos. It can take a blurry, low-resolution image and turn it into a sharp, detailed portrait.

all_reviews.author: amanda K
all_reviews.text: Unless you're enhancing photos, don't even bother trying the AI generated portion of the app. I've uploaded, re-uploaded, Uninstalled, reinstalled, deleted profile, re-did new profile - over a dozen times and it will only keep the original set of (8) photos I selected. Very disappointing because the app has potential if it would just work properly.

all_reviews.author: Kiernen
all_reviews.text: Evaluation: Definitely Worth Getting Much like other applications similar to this one I had expected to be greeted by a paywall, which in turn would cause me to uninstall the app immediately. Instead, I was greeted with instructions and a simple and clear example as to how you can expect your images to look after enhancing them. You can pay for a subscription which gives you unlimited photo enhancements in 1 day whereas the free version gives you 5 free enhancements per day. Pretty damn good

all_reviews.author: Marie Deschamps
all_reviews.text: I don't know how I fell about this app. It works well for the most part. Sometimes it makes phots look really weird. I paid for the one month option because you can only do a few photos for free. After paying for one month I was still only able to do a couple more photos before it asked me to buy more pro cards for $7 for 5 when I supposedly subscribed for a month for $7. $14 to make a couple of photos clear is not worth it imo. - at all

all_reviews.author: Roberto Sanchez
all_reviews.text: I have tried many AI photo enhancement applications. This one is the best. The result is very natural and realistic and very high quality. Other apps give paint-like results. Remini is perfect, Maybe a little glossy but not too much. I wish they would offer a single payment option. Renting an app is not useful unless you are a photographer and always use it.

all_reviews.author: Kathy Sexton
all_reviews.text: Used to be a great app. They removed all of the good features. I will not be renewing as the only feature left is to sharpen photos and I can do that with Gimp. I may consider in the future if they bring back the colorization. Any body that has the old version still has that but I had to get a new phone and had to download new version. It's a waste of money now.

all_reviews.author: Taliah Hemphill
all_reviews.text: I honestly wasn't expecting it to work so well. All my low-quality photos can become high-quality in just the click of a button. I also looove the feature that you can make an image cartoon-like. The only thing I would change is I wish for unsubscribed users, you could more than just 5 photos a day. Like common 5 . No need to be stingy, you could do atleast 10-15.

all_reviews.author: Paul “Quillpen77” Ramey
all_reviews.text: I like what you've done with the new update giving more control back to users for restoring purchases, giving us a heads up here, and informing us about the changes being made as well as a little tweaking to the subscription price. If you'd only done this from the beginning, a lot suspicions, bad ratings, and subscription cancellations could've been saved.

all_reviews.author: Cody Baugher
all_reviews.text: I actually like the app the only reason it gets a two-star is because I accidentally stumbled upon trickery, you can use it for free and I only have to watch 3 ads for each photo and when your photo is distorted it works wonders but try having them enhance a photo that doesn't need much enhancement then compare there before part of the before and after to your original photo you'll see they intentionally distorted it to make the difference greater. Not cool-3 stars for trickery!

all_reviews.author: Gerzee Witzman
all_reviews.text: Really love the app, and I only had it for one day! Sure, the images don't look PERFECT, but they look good enough. They end up a little distorted but it's ok. The backgrounds don't look very good but i don't care much about background, just the main thing in the picture. I downloaded this app to make a picture I have made into a poster but the picture was really blurry. Now, other than background distortions, it looks fine. Wish you didn't have to watch adds for almost every action, though.

all_reviews.author: Sahil_editor__786 Xmart sahil
all_reviews.text: I've got to say, the Remini app is a total game-changer! It's an Al-powered photo editing tool that can take your low-quality photos and turn them into stunning, high-definition images. I've seen it work its magic on old, blurry photos, and the results are nothing short of amazing. One of the standout features of Remini is its ability to enhance faces in photos. It can take a blurry, low-resolution image and turn it into a sharp, detailed portrait.

all_reviews.author: Kelly McLean
all_reviews.text: The results of the retouched photos are amazing, the app itself is a nightmare. I can never find the pictures in my folders that I am wanting to edit, no matter what folder I move the photo to, and it is laggy to the point of frustration. It also blurs around the face, which ruins some photos. I wish it was easier and less irritating to use.

all_reviews.author: Deano
all_reviews.text: The app got worse since I last used it, but the ads got longer & more annoying 😡 2 min ad before I start yet it got stuck trying to upload a 78kb photo. imagine trying to upload a bigger photo 😅 I quit the app several times, it just wouldn't upload. I tried a different photo, not having it. You get punished if you quit the app during an ad. I quit because I hadn't even chosen a photo. Bear in mind that I'd already watched several long ads and didn't like the results enough to save them 👎

all_reviews.author: Siddhesh Yadav
all_reviews.text: Worst app, too many ads! For uploading - ads. For selecting the picture - ads. And even if somehow the picture gets uploaded, after the process is completed, you have to watch around six more ads just to save it. And still, there’s no guarantee that your picture will actually get saved. Also, there’s not much difference between the previous and the new photo — just a little increase in light and contrast, which anyone can easily do using the normal editing options. In short,waste of time 😡😡

all_reviews.author: D
all_reviews.text: The after reveal was atrocious, absolutely horrible. The pictures and transformation you show us look amazing and unbelievable, but when I tried it was horrific! I had to watch and ad each time before I could even transform my photo, and you have to pay for a lot of the things on the app. I'm pretty sure they just get non blurry good pictures too advertise and make them blurry instead.

all_reviews.author: TuRon Davis
all_reviews.text: I wish I could give this app a zero. About a year ago this app was excellent. It generated realistic photos of myself, along with being consistent with my hair texture and skin tone. Now no matter how much I delete the original model, the same type of pictures keep generating. These new generated photos recreate me as a white man with straight hair when I'm clearly African-American. This app has become a pure joke! Don't waste your time nor money with it until they fix it!

all_reviews.author: Laney
all_reviews.text: This app has went downhill since I first discovered it. Overloaded with ads— and where did all the different options go??? There used to be options for enhancement, coloring black and white pictures, and removing scratches from old photos. Also the quality of the enhancement has went downhill as well. I miss the old Remini. :(

all_reviews.author: iviqen ken
all_reviews.text: Based on My Experience, I didn't encounter alot of problems back then but when I uninstalled Remini and Installed it again I was surprised to see that the Login and Retro Option is not there aswell as the other Options all i see was Enhance and Enhance +, I've been waiting for the update and it finally came although when i checked Remini it still didn't update thats why I tried to contact Remini on Instagram, Email, and other more! Although I didn't see and Response from the Team. Please fix it

all_reviews.author: Dick Saggs
all_reviews.text: Free trial doesn't work.. you can't use your Google Play balance / payment card for the 1 week free trial (it comes up as a processing error) but "coincidentally" you're able to purchase the one week 🤔 I had $7+ on my google play, couldn't do a week trial but i was able to pay $3 for a week using the same method? Money hungry developers. Good thing my balance was accumulated from surveys or I'd be more pissed!

all_reviews.author: bridget dela torre
all_reviews.text: Remini is my go to app esp when I am editing a portrait for a certain person. But just recently, I kept on disconnected from the network (it says) though I have an internet. That's why I uninstalled it and re-install it after. And I got an upgraded app, it has a totally new features in which I don't find it appealing. Everything seems weird. And I thought I could have much better experience when I subscribed to and when I did, it's really not worth it. I prefer the old version.

all_reviews.author: Josh Jenkins
all_reviews.text: A once useful app to sharpen older or lower resolution images now leaves a cheap waxy look over skin tones. The app is now far more about filters and AI renders found everywhere else, whilst it's also not cheap, and the free version is overblown with long ads that appear with neatly every menu click. This used to be a must-have app, but now it's like a thousand shoddy others and I'd recommend avoiding. It's limited edit features certainly don't justify the cost of 'Pro'.

all_reviews.author: Liam
all_reviews.text: The app is great and legit; it really enhances your blurred photos. But after the update, when I tried to unable the “color” changer thing on the photo, because I don't like it, it kept going back all the time on the finished product. It's really annoying! Because I wasted my time (I watch ads to use remini).

all_reviews.author: Chantel Wensley
all_reviews.text: some weird textural things in the photo after...blurred..and distorted. but honestly, just the smallest amount of clarity is a relief. I've been waiting so long for a way to bring back my pixelated photos. I had imported all my photos of my babies from instagram and it imported small and pixelated...i never realized that I til i had deleted the instagram account, in essence..losing everything of my children ....so this is pretty great regardless.

all_reviews.author: Bakshi Mahfooz
all_reviews.text: The app was working fine at the beginning but after some time it stopped working and was showing, adding pixels…. Removing blur..... etc. then at last when you finish watching ads it shows" Something Went Wrong”. To eradicate the problem, I uninstalled and then re-installed the app, but it didn't help out, so for this reason, I'm giving it 1 star I would have given zero stars, but I had no option!

all_reviews.author: Heavenly Words
all_reviews.text: Remini is no longer effective unlike before. The app before sharpens the images and create a great quality photos. They no longer effective and the only thing they do now is brighten the photo, which you can do on other app. Worst part is I paid for a week and its useless. Also after it expires, the ads takes too long before you can use the app, next is the app keeps loading and sometimes yoh wonder if they will really release the final photo in the end. It's no longer useful sadly.

all_reviews.author: Megan Boström
all_reviews.text: Probably one of the better enhancement apps out there, BUT with the new update I really wish it didn't automatically adjust the lighting in certain photos because it tends to completely wash out the image. I wish it was like a side option. Also I feel like its trying to almost airbrush my photos, and taking away that much texture can just kind of make it look worse

all_reviews.author: muhammad owais
all_reviews.text: I am very disappointed with this app. For every single picture I try to enhance, I have to watch at least 10 ads. It feels more like an advertising platform than a photo editing app. The number of ads is extremely frustrating and wastes so much time. The app experience is completely ruined because of constant interruptions. I would not recommend it unless they seriously reduce the number of ads.

all_reviews.author: Matt Timms
all_reviews.text: Been using the free version of this app for over 2 years. Like others have said, the amount of ads thrown at you is ridiculous. Photo quality has gone way down and the results after editing doesn't look as crisp anymore. Also, they cheekily put a 'Remini' watermark on every image you edit now which wasn't there before. Uninstalled.

all_reviews.author: qwerty qwerty
all_reviews.text: This app has become nothing but an ad farm. I had to sit through 10+ ads, each promising that my photo would be enhanced after watching — but guess what? Nothing actually happens. The image stays the same, and the app just throws another ad in your face, pretending it’s “processing” again. It's a scammy loop — trick you into watching ads, show fake progress, then repeat. No real enhancement, no result, just endless monetization tactics. Used to be decent. Now it's just bait-and-switch garbage.

all_reviews.author: Atharv
all_reviews.text: There are ads. And then there are ads after ads. And guess what is after those ads? Yes. More ads!! With every click you do, you'll see half a dozen ads, half of out of which are unskippable 40/60 seconds ads. So, if you're a fan of ads with literally no true work being achieved, go ahead and install the app. Remini - There are apps and sites which do a lot better with a lot less. When you give a dozen ads for 2 clicks, AT tHE VERY LEAST have the decency to give some real product at the end.

all_reviews.author: Sivanandan Mahalingam
all_reviews.text: I am a paid pro user for couple of months. Most of the features were not working. The animate feature did not work at all. I have contacted the remini team multiple times, the support team response is usually a delayed one (to respond they took days). It took close to 30 days to fix. By the time my subscription ended. However, on request, they have extended my paid subscription for additional one month. On a positive note, the enhanced feature is really really good.

all_reviews.author: Peter Menner
all_reviews.text: Listen to the recent poor reviews! New owners bought the "Remini" name and the mobile front-end app, removed access to most of the third-party image processing features (probably to save money), gaslighted customers by calling them "improvements", then changed account access (no more username/password logins) so subscriptions are only accessible on the platform you buy the subscription (either iOS or Android, but not both).

all_reviews.author: ZEZE AMEN
all_reviews.text: One star because we are allowed to adjust only 5 photos and then the program closes for many hours before it makes 5 more. Frankly, this is a very bad update and does not help this program to be good and better for me to use. I hope you update the program again and open it so that it can take as many pictures as possible without closing for so many hours.

all_reviews.author: Mc Donnell Escalona
all_reviews.text: The app is excellent but not good for free users. Too much ads! Every click you do, you have to watch 1-2 ads. And, when you download the image you have to watch 2-3 ads! That's insane! Before, the ads is just when you only download the image. But now, every click you do, contains ads. Because of this I uninstalled this app.

all_reviews.author: Melanie Storie
all_reviews.text: This app used to be really nice, and also free user friendly. I used to be able to use the AI and cartoon filters up to three times a day for free, and there were ads, but it was still acceptable. Now the only thing I can do is enhance a photo and it plays an ad or two for every single thing I click. Not worth it anymore.

all_reviews.author: Mario Gallardo
all_reviews.text: I am impressed, only tried it twice. I will try it again before I give it 5 stars. I lowered my rating from 4 to 3 stars, because I looked at the picture that looks amazing as I enlarge the picture....I saw what looks like dripping paint. Developers....One question, if I get photograph printed, will I see the dripping paint I am mentioning...??? The photograph is 5 star product, don't get me wrong. The best there is, just giving this app a fare shake because before I provided a low rating.

all_reviews.author: Ben James
all_reviews.text: Used to be amazing, now not so good. Enhanced faces look a little cartoonish now, and the avatars are samey and not very realistic - they used to be impressive. Worst thing is the advert traps, forcing you to restart or open Google Play or endlessly circle round in some sort of ad purgatory. I'm forced to look for alternatives but hope these issues are sorted out.

all_reviews.author: Fishxy
all_reviews.text: At first I almost ditched this app completely because I had only limited uses. However I bought the ability to have unlimited access to enhance photos with no ads and its great! 95% of the time I'd say the app manages to fix photos really well. Sometimes it fails to realize what exactly its fixing and sometimes just doesn't do it at all. But very rarely does it do that. Great app, 5 stars.

all_reviews.author: Behina Sam
all_reviews.text: I really liked this app but i had to delete it when I needed more space on my phone ,I re downloaded it now and noticed that they had got rid of free enchantment for vids and want to get rid of history feature too. WHAT? It's such a dumb decision. history feature is one of the last options to delete. And I think you should give more to paying accounts, instead of taking something from free users and making it pay only. Both free and paying accounts deserved more.

all_reviews.author: Yura Reed
all_reviews.text: It's a great app, though editing pictures has limits, and if you want to unlimitedly edit pictures you have to subscribe which cost money. I really hope we can edit pictures without limitations, I mean it's a great app but it's too pricey. I'm just 14 editing stuff😗 I don't even have money in me. I just hope we could edit pictures without limits. Great app tho❤️

all_reviews.author: Dan Meno BellinghamWA
all_reviews.text: Looks like you've got a long line of disappointed customers following your latest revision of your app. I'm a professionally photo editor, and previously have subscribed. Renew my membership today only spend a lot of time trying to understand the new interface, and most importantly, coming away VERY disappointed in finding the B&W to Color feature gone. Booooo! Cancelled my subscription immediately.

all_reviews.author: Mohammad Golam Martuza
all_reviews.text: It makes photo really clear, but if you are not going to pay an insane amount of money then you have to see atleast 3 videos to enhance 1 picture which is absolutely absurd. And again you can edit only 5 photos in 1 day! Now it is showing "no connection" even though my network signal is excellent and I can use other apps just fine. I tried to uninstall then install it again but it is still not working!!! Fix this bug please!!!!!!!

all_reviews.author: Sime Said
all_reviews.text: When the algorithm gets it right this app produces some ABSOLUTELY BRILLIANT RESULTS. I'm a pretty keen amateur photographer, and I can tell you from experience that there are a fairly limited number of things you can do to kick some life back into degraded photos - and mostly then its about removing detail, not adding it as Remini does. This is an easy to use, friendly app, with a free option available, and when it gets it right the results are SIMPLY AMAZING 😮 HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

all_reviews.author: Graciela
all_reviews.text: The newest version is sucks. Even though I already enhanced a photo, the quality wasn't changed at all. Because of that, I decided to enhance one more time. Unfortunately, I couldn't enhance it 'cause it was only able for premium user. Besides, every time I wanted to enhance a photo, I always had to watched an ad. So yeah, I uninstalled it :)

all_reviews.author: Yassine El Ouazzani
all_reviews.text: i wish this app didn't have that many ads it genuinely is amazing, but there's so many ads to do the simplests of tasks and you can't even skip you just have to sit through a bunch of 30s ads, and if you don't want ads, you can't even buy the program, you have to subscribe and keep paying for it as long as you're using it, seriously subscription has a time and place you can't just make a program that solves one problem and then put a subscription plan for it, I'm not gonna use it daily.

all_reviews.author: Endangered Species
all_reviews.text: It is unable to enhance side faces or any face at an angle. In some photos highlights, rimlights oddly become too bright and unusable. Face beautifier is unnecessary for most cases as it is changing the face. Colors is 50/50, for low-light photos it was good, but for already bright photos it is too bright. It is better... if those are optional. it will help in speeding up the enhancement process a lot.

all_reviews.author: Blue Jan
all_reviews.text: 😡 This app is beyond frustrating! The free version is nothing but nonstop ads. Showing 1–2 ads of 30 seconds would be acceptable, but here it’s just endless. For every tiny action, ads start playing. They claim it’s 15 seconds, but in reality it drags on for 1–1.5 minutes! 🤯 Many times I have to force close the app and reopen it just to make it work again. 🔥 Totally unacceptable! I do NOT recommend this app at all. 🚫 Stay away from this garbage and save your time!

all_reviews.author: Tara “Sweet T” Diaz
all_reviews.text: I would give this app 5 stars.. HOWEVER, I absolutely HATE that now any time I use the "turn into an illustration" feature on my photos, there is no longer any variety in the images it spits out. They all look like the exact same art style as the "profile picture generator" one, ever since that feature was added. PLEASE bring back all the cute & quirky cartoon styles that are still being shown on the example photos for "turn into an illustration" — it was my favorite part of the app!!!

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: This app does really well for enhancing my photos! The main problem I have with it is that I can't share my photos directly to the app, I have to come to the app first and scroll and look for the photo I want. I have over 24k photos so it takes forever to fine the one I want. Now sure how they can fix this. It's also annoying we got only 3 free a day, the actual Chinese version through wechat gives you 10 free credits a day... It does the job well so for now it's worth it

all_reviews.author: Yzavela Narvaez
all_reviews.text: Remini deserves zero stars! This app is freaking crazy! Once it enhances a pic, it's a 50/50 chance you get the actual pic but most times, omg, my friend and I get the strangest most demonic looking enhanced pics! Faces that don't belong appear where they shouldn't and half the time it completely changes a person's face altogether and it's not from the original uploaded pic! I think the developers need to look into this because I have screenshots of all the strange faces! The samples are false!

all_reviews.author: Dexine Lei Manapeng
all_reviews.text: I experienced the same issues as others. I can't guarantee if this works for others but, it did with 3 of my friends who uses Remini. Click on the 7 day free trial, edit as much photos that you want, then cancel it. You can still unblur photos even after unsubscribing. This kinda likes, restart? the app itself...idk. No matter how much I uninstalled and reinstalled this app, it doesn't work. I would still prefer the old version tbh.

all_reviews.author: Bianca JC Wright
all_reviews.text: Good GAWD, what happened to this app? I was given so many options, not just as a paying user but non paying as well. It now seems that I can't use any more presets without being redirected to the subscription panel. The results of the sets now are awful. The placement of my face into the presets is misaligned, and it's making me look 5 shades lighter than I actually am. I didn't have these issues before. No, ma'am.

all_reviews.author: Denise Boulet
all_reviews.text: The app does great work, but I paid for it weekly for two months, and it would not let me use ANY of my premium features. It would just ask me to purchase premium. I tried to restore my purchase over and over, but an error message would come up. I love the app. The AI photos are extraordinary, and the photo enhancer is awesome... But I've paid over $20 for features I still had to watch ads to access.

all_reviews.author: Shaun
all_reviews.text: Interminable adverts & poor results. Remini used to be my go to app for image improvement I've had the paid version in the past, it's always been expensive when compared to other AI Enhancement apps, but these days the price doesn't come close to other apps in the market. The only time it comes close to working successfully is if there's only a minor quality difference and I mean miniscule difference. The advertising goes on forever, when you open the app, again on uploading & again to download.

all_reviews.author: Michael Gari (Dj Thirst)
all_reviews.text: Was nice when it worked. I used it about ten times total, then suddenly it quit working. App would load up, pics and all, but when I click on a pic, it just said skip after 5 secs then goes back to my pics, not enhancing nothing no matter what pic I choose from folders I'm enhancing. It's up to date and all so dunno.. also it would be nice if it enhanced the entire picture instead of just a face, there's no sense of having a clear face on a blurry body/background LOL

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: I'm amazed by the details of the enhanced results. This app even made the skin texture visible and correct pupils to heavily pixelated eyes. The enhancing itself definitely deserved 5 stars. I don't mind to watch an ad to enhance a photo. But you guys should improve the availability of ads because most of the time there is no ad available. And then there is a privacy concern because the photos will be stored in cloud after you enhanced them.

all_reviews.author: Benjamín Gallardo
all_reviews.text: Easy to handle and pretty straightforward. The results are nice enough for the price of watching 2 ads (1 for rendering and another for saving the pic). I didn't like so much that the app shows the possibility of "2 better PRO options" but doesn't show any glimpse of the PRO version results without subscribing for weekly pay. Maybe you can show the results first, with a watermark for example, so we can see if those results are actually worth paying for without wasting time? Anyways, nice app.

all_reviews.author: Christine Joy Manzano
all_reviews.text: I give 3 stars because I much like the old remini than the updated one. I don't like the updated remini because its change the appearance of the picture specially on filter it's more like warm tone and more brightness that's why I'm not satisfied for the outcome. Also on saving picture after the enchantment. I can't save my pics because I reach the limit? Though I didn't use remini all the time. Please bring back the old style of remini just focus on enchancing the picture thank you.

all_reviews.author: mirza khan
all_reviews.text: Remini! That's a popular photo editing app that uses AI to enhance and restore old or damaged photos. It's great for giving new life to cherished memories and making them look sharper and more vibrant. Remini uses machine learning algorithms to automatically detect and fix issues like blur, noise, and scratches, and can even colorize black and white photos or add color to faded images.

all_reviews.author: Arnab Sil
all_reviews.text: Fantastic results. After trying many AI photo enhancement apps and close scrutinying the results, I think this is probably the best of the lot. Not only for Face but for other textures in the image as well. Only thing is cost. For casual shooters and hobbyists, Rs. 250 a week is very steep. I don't know why it suddenly shot from Rs. 80 a week to 250 a week.

all_reviews.author: Charlesetta Beasley
all_reviews.text: The apl was far better about 2 years ago. I uploaded about 8 pictures, and it created many different pictures from different settings. The picture looked like me and was my size. The current setting has super skinny people and a face that is similar but doesn't look like me, and I can only complete a picture from one section at a time. I definitely would have given the app 10 stars when I used it before.

all_reviews.author: Andre Ivey
all_reviews.text: While it works ok most of the time it is not worth the price or the number of ads without the premium. Firstly, it suggests you enhance all photos and not just blurry ones, it doesn't work for gifs, and premium is WEEKLY so in actuality you pay 12 bucks a month for an app you barely use and that isn't guaranteed to have desired results for your photos. Do NOT purchase!!!!

all_reviews.author: Annika Ohlin
all_reviews.text: I was really grateful when the devs replied that they made sure that the old algorithm could still be found under the "more" tab. Now, months later they've removed it completely and the app is now back to being useless for me personally, as the standard Enhance algorithm completely butchers the type of images that I use it for. I would also prefer it if you could preview image results before spending tokens on them, as some photos just get ruined in the end and will have wasted your tokens.

all_reviews.author: Jessica Marie Michelle
all_reviews.text: I pay for the subscription every week and this new update RUINED it. The pictures are distorted and it overlaps the original color of the photo. You can't even use your own original photo because the Remini app destroys the quality of it. I don't know what happened with the new update but the developers need to fix it. I should be getting a refund for their mistake! FIX IT PLEASE AND THANK YOU!!!!

all_reviews.author: The Budoka Sound
all_reviews.text: I just subscribed for 3 months and then updated the app and its totally different now. All I can do is enhance photos. Before I updated I could do all kinds of things. You also took a monthly subscription payment as well as well the subscription payment for 3 months. I feel really cheated and ripped off. I want my money back because I've paid for something thats nowhere near as good as it was. Before the update I'd have given five stars.

all_reviews.author: Jaidyn Carter
all_reviews.text: I gave this 4 stars instead of five because if you want more than five images inhanced a day, you'd have to pay money for a subscription. Also before and after each image enhancement there is a 30 second ad. But the image quality is amazing and it's really good at guessing what an image is supposed to look like. Great app, would recommend.

all_reviews.author: Farmina Dimakuta
all_reviews.text: When I first tried remini, i was mesmerize of how fascinating it was, but after it was updated, a lot of bugs happens, plus it doesn't even enhance your face, rather, it facewash you! i once tried this one with one of my photo which wasn't even accurate to my skin tone, so disappointing! It also keep glitching, I tried to enhance one of my photo and it says error, I even need to redownload it just so I could use it without glitching. Probably the most disappointing update ever.

all_reviews.author: Amelia Lafferty
all_reviews.text: WAY too spendy and no longer as good as it once was. Ads ads ads on the free version. But the worst is how everything is completely whited out it seems. You take the colors out of my images and just make them so white. My partner's face, nicely colored but then all the color is taken out and he looks like this glowing moon in the middle of the environment. It never used to be like that. To do any little thing with it you get inundated with really long ads and that sucks. You guys got greedy.

all_reviews.author: Sarah Relhcteh
all_reviews.text: This used to be an amazing app. It had great tools that really took photos to the next level. Before, I thought only having 5 free edits a day was bad, but now... this app is useless. All the tools are gone and you have to watch an ad to start the enhance AND to save it. BUT WAIT... there's more! You still can only do that 5 times a day 🙄 You can't even enhance further on the same credit anymore. What a waste of a good app. RIP Remini.

all_reviews.author: Kit Llacer
all_reviews.text: Kinda expensive for what it does, i've been paying for this for a while now but i might drop it. I have other paid apps that do most of the same that i only have to pay once instead of weekly. There was one AI filter i really liked (i think it was animal toon or toy or something) and now it's no longer available, replaced by some dumb pumpkin filter that doesn't even look good.

all_reviews.author: kittyballs rosal
all_reviews.text: it's so buggy...gotta keep opening it and reclosing til it works. once you finally get the ad to work so it can enhance your pic, it makes you watch another ad so you can be able to save pic. it almost usually bugs out and you have to close app an rewatch two more ads again to finally save the pic, im tired of making this app extra money just because they can't get their app to work right. goodbye remini, hello Picma

all_reviews.author: Rylie Rollon
all_reviews.text: The result is very satisfying but the process sucks. Especially when creating task, it takes so long and even if my network connection is strong it still says "network request timeout" "check your internet connection" and it's freaking annoying! Please fix this, it's only the disappointing thing about remini but leads me to just uninstall it rather than break my mood even more.

all_reviews.author: Shawn Meilicke
all_reviews.text: Amazing app with a horrible business model. Photos are uploaded for them to be edited, they're not edited locally. They want $5 a month for unlimited basic editing and MORE MONEY to use the "advanced features". You have to by "pro tokens" and every pic edited consumes one, regardless of if you like the results. This app seems to be the absolute best at what it does on the app market, but I don't think it's worth the price of admission.

all_reviews.author: Will
all_reviews.text: It's got a nice presentation but don't let that fool you. It "enhanced" my photos by just making them lighter. First disappointment, the ads are not worth the wait. Tried the AI avatar maker, and it's only at the last moment that it tells you to pay with the weekly sub. Of course saying the first week is free when you still gotta pay. This app is a scam.

all_reviews.author: Arlie Ellado
all_reviews.text: Not even using it yet it tho. I open the app and it takes too long and take me back to my homescreen, it lags inside the app, takes too much time for the photo to loads, needs too much data, and yet it's not working, it's not make the photo have a high quality!. It's not really are a persons photo or a place, animals photo but it's a paper that has a detail. It is so important photo of a paper that my mom needed already too bad even this app can't clear the photo....

all_reviews.author: James Kane
all_reviews.text: This works pretty well. If this is your thing then Remini is a great tool to have. I see some people are not to happy with the product but my advice would be not to expect miracles. I like to crop my photos first to take the portion of the picture I want and leave out the rest. This allows a better chance of success. This works within limits. Close up pics work most of the time but long or wide shots with people far back in the distance may not have the correct geometric features to work.

all_reviews.author: Morgan K
all_reviews.text: Used to be a good app... not anymore, however. Every picture to enhance makes a 30-second add pop up and a 5-second add to export it. Before when the app was released it was able to enhance the entire photo and make everything look nice and clear, now however hard I try it will only recognise faces and when it manages to do that, zooming in makes them look like they are painted.. all wonkey and out of shape. This is not a good app anymore unless they decide to revert it to an extent.

all_reviews.author: Ardhyan D.
all_reviews.text: Yes, this app does enhance your photos. Perhaps do very good quality works for some people. Yet, every time I click a single feature or a single option, they are asking for ads to use that feature. For example, when you click Enhance Face and then every option (1, 2, 3,etc) has each one ads. Not only that, when you click "Disable" for the said feature, it also show you an ads. I'm sorry. I understand you need ads for free user but I feel so uncomfortable with 70-80% my time viewing ads.

all_reviews.author: Rajakumar Kumbar
all_reviews.text: Pretty good. The pics after being enhanced have a much better resolution than before and that's nice but the no. of ads is quite annoying. We have to watch an ad for selecting a pic and one more ad for downloading it after enhancing plus the normal popped up ads too. At least let us select a pic without an ad without subscription. Please fix that issue asap cuz it's very boring to watch an ad for 30 sec, enhance the pic for a sec and then one more big ad for downloading for 30s.

all_reviews.author: Somen Rajak
all_reviews.text: Too many ads. It used to be good and one ad to enhance a photo made sense. But now after every click no matter where, it opens up and starts playing an ad. It's seriously very annoying. It has become more like ad center and less like any decent app which enhances photo. Most of the time I don't want to enhance my photos because i would be bombarded with loads of ads. Highly disappointed. Very very very bad.

all_reviews.author: Jenni Talbot
all_reviews.text: Lame.
