Bye bye app. It lasted all of 5 minutes on my phone, 4.5 minutes of which were spent on ads. And it asks really dumb questions below your review, with limited answer options. "No" or "not sure"? Where is "yes"?

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: I used to love this app, paid for the year, and used it regularly. Thought I cancelled, but ended up paying another year. That was fine since I liked it, but now there are no new AI photo templates, and there hasn't been in a very long time. Why are there no new AI photos, not the videos or cartoon images. I am paying for an app that I never use now.

all_reviews.author: Nicola Dennis
all_reviews.text: I really like the photo enhancer and it's free so I decided to pay for the video enhancer option as well and that's where I went wrong. I want to enhance a short video of 10 min 7 sec so it said buy 61 pro cards. I paid £4.79 that's the minimum amount needed to buy pro cards but it only shows you the amount of pro cards after you buy it which was 7 pro cards😱I calculated how much it would cost and the amount seems unbelievable for such a short video.This experience has left me feeling cheated.

all_reviews.author: Theo Frank
all_reviews.text: I've used this app a few times and only the enhance feature. Does an incredible job on blurry faces. Although once it did something weird to my Gums making my teeth look really short (.. if there was a way to spot edit & unedit, it'd probably fix this) overall I'm extremely happy with the Ad version. Just me but I have found use for some of the ad apps as well. And since all I was looking for was a photo enhancement to begin with, I'd say it's done it's job.

all_reviews.author: Jelu Canson
all_reviews.text: The idea of adding more "free" is much better so we can enhance more pictures a day. But the problem is, whenever I want to enhance a picture, it keeps showing "network request timeout(0)". I don't know if the problem is in my phone or the model, or in the application itself. Please fix this. I'm getting irritated already.

all_reviews.author: Kimi
all_reviews.text: honestly it's a really neat app which I enjoyed using so much for the one week free trial, but then it's really expensive when compared to other similar ones just like it, many of which are free to use if your willing to sit thru watching some ads. I'm a broke college student so I can't afford it even though I do love using it. if they ever lowered the price it would be a five star app all around and I would change my rating but for now it's simply unaffordable for me personally, unfortunately

all_reviews.author: Tawakal Abdi
all_reviews.text: Too much ads. Im okay with watch ad to enhance photo, but then force me to watch full 1 minute ads just for download? You guys just greedy. UI is worse too and really confusing compare to the old version. The enhanced picture have bug too. The date on those pictures go to year 5300 lol and because of that, the enhanced pictures is always on first in recent files view. It just messed up.

all_reviews.author: Nick Weaver
all_reviews.text: Used this app for 2 years not a single problem but apparently they're money hungry and can't stand just making a good app. Yoy getvan ad as soon as toy open the app, if you click on anything you get an ad, when yoy try and process a photo you get an ad... and half the time it doesn't even process the photo, it just plays an ad for 1min and then closes everything.

all_reviews.author: Artha Suryana
all_reviews.text: The photo enhancement on old version is so much better. This new version has 3 version of enhancement but none of them is as good as the one on the old remini. The new version is increasing the file resolution but the actual file size is decreased, so you lost a lot of details on your photos except on the face area. Please bring back the old remini enhancement or i don't think i'll keep subscribing.

all_reviews.author: RÎ
all_reviews.text: It used to be the best one for photo enhancing, but for the last 2 months It isn't same as before, it got even worse, they lessen some of the features, like the beautifying options are only 1 now instead of 2 and the colour filter also only 3 instead of 5 and enhanced photo looks like a painting , it isn't crisp & sharp anymore . And maximum of the time the server is down, so can't get the desirable things anymore. 😞 Please, @Remini team look after this matter & fix this as early as possible.🙇

all_reviews.author: Zahng Lee
all_reviews.text: Doesn't tell you that you have a limited attempts of choosing the right picture even though you haven't downloaded it or even selected it as the one that you want ... then it will force you to purchase the subscription .... problem is I don't use or need this service for most of my daily routine, I just happen to need it for this one thing and thats it !!, also AI enhanced images Change facial features like the size of my nose instead clearing the skin or put more light in to it

all_reviews.author: Alamelu Ragu
all_reviews.text: Their editing is good. But there are too many adds, sometime there are two add in a row and you can't skip eat so you have to watch one minute, and if you want to save your photo then you have to watch add one more time. So irritating, actually they want to frustrated you, and day one that you will buy their subscription. Is not possible to buy a subscription. For free users like us, day by day this app is becoming more and more irritating.

all_reviews.author: Donna
all_reviews.text: From two stars to one star. Remini is such a great app before, but now, the app is very limited and not friendly user anymore. It can only enhance images that aren't too blurred, if it does, you get a strange demonic face enhanced pics! lol. It's funny and at the same time annoying! And the most important thing is it doesn't enhanced the whole pic, it only clears the face. I do not recommend this app anymore, such a waste of time.

all_reviews.author: Kine Dump
all_reviews.text: I don’t usually leave reviews for apps I download, but this one really tested my patience because of the ads. I’ve been using it for a long time, and before, there were either no ads or just one to three ads per photo I wanted to enhance. But now, I don’t know what happened—every single tap triggers an ad. Whenever I try to enhance something, another ad pops up. It’s so frustrating. I’m never downloading this app again.

all_reviews.author: Hannah G
all_reviews.text: App used to be great (not now). Previously, at least half the results were quite real looking. Load times were super long, but the results were great. Now, the load time is much faster, but the results are terrible. I have not yet had one that looked realistic since the change. Super disappointing change.

all_reviews.author: Sourav
all_reviews.text: Before you start editing & also before you save your edited photos in gallery, you have to watch 30s ad each and everytime, which pisses me off a bit. But the edited pics are really worth it, almost DSLR quality. The images doesn't tear up, no matter how much you zoom. Pretty well done. I'm only giving 4star because of ads, or else it deserves 5.

all_reviews.author: J C W
all_reviews.text: Amazing on many photos, laughable in others. Concerns are the app crashes a few times and also, in terms of the video enhancer, it says that the pro cards will be used to enhance 10sec videos. I have short clips of less than 10secs and its unclear whether its for any video or videos longer than 10 secs which is what I assume. It would be better if the pro cards were used for videos longer than 10secs. Overall, still a good app.

all_reviews.author: Mike Hardie
all_reviews.text: So. Many. Ads!! It's ridiculous. I'd go as far as to say that this app has more ads than any other I've ever used. This bombardment and intrusion of ads doesn't make me want to buy the ad-free pro version, it makes me want to delete the app and leave a one-star review. Change your business model or you'll wave goodbye to a lot of revenue.

all_reviews.author: Gsum85 The lost Explorer
all_reviews.text: It's Scam it just smooths out the photo I do professional photography myself. I clicked on part 2 in the app on my eyes and it said it was blurry it cleared up but on my normal photo my eyes was crisp I'm using s21ultra. I've also used it on very old photographs from 1980s and it didn't clear it up. I did a better job photo editing myself. I never wanted to write this review but when u trying to scam people to access pro version and only gain money from 30 seconds advertisements.

all_reviews.author: Maria
all_reviews.text: Actually a very good AI app for lots of fun with your pics and videos. I don't tend to use AI generated pictures besides just fun but I did end up putting one as my LinkedIn, as it was not too AI looking. I do wish there was a way to say - hey leave thos wrinkles and skin texture as is. Maybe a kind of a slider how much smoothing u want to happen could be provided? As that's usually what ends up being too "fake" looking. Anyway, still tons of fun and value for a free try out period.

all_reviews.author: A Google user
all_reviews.text: It's okay when it works but for the most part it's unreliable . It used to be better before the upgrade added with ads, at least you had 3 guarentee edits. Now you never know when there is an ad. If there is no ad. You can't edit your photo for free. Even then sometimes the edits are worse than the original.

all_reviews.author: Tyler Ray Matters
all_reviews.text: I don't know what happened to this app, but I'm deleting it. No one wants and app that just enhances pictures. Not when before it would animate a still photo. I'm just saying, that is very low quality. Did so much more. I say don't be fooled by the downloads and reviews, that's when it actually did something. If I wanted a good photo, I'd focus my camera. Just that simple, does it. Not like we're at a 1998 Nokia stage. Virgin Mobile did better than that.

all_reviews.author: Kayla DeMarco
all_reviews.text: I wish you could edit more with less ads. Apps like PicsArt you can edit all you want all day and certain features are part of the pro plan. In this app you have to watch a 30 second ad every time and can only do so many pics per day. What if I don't like the results? Oh well, waste of one of your edits...... So irritating. Great app otherwise but come on!

all_reviews.author: De W
all_reviews.text: It's pretty cool...but the app has done some strange things. It made some ancestors of mine look like they had been maimed in a fire or something. At first I thought that maybe I just didn't notice in the originals, but I zoomed in to one that the app made it look like some of his hair had been burned off at some point. It was barely looking. When I zoomed in though, his hair looked fine.

all_reviews.author: Chaitanya Kamat

They say they'll show you two ads, but they actually show four full-length ads. I find that really exciting. It's just that the app needs me to upload a photo everytime I want to watch four ads in a row. Please fix that. If you let me watch ads without uploading a photo, I'll give you five stars.

all_reviews.author: Carlo Volti
all_reviews.text: All over the web press advertised as having a free option. Lies. It also will not run if you disable Play store and it won't recognize if you're online. Don't waste your time. No matter where you install it from our tells you you're not using a official play store version - even when installed from play store!

all_reviews.author: #BʟᴏᴏᴅPᴏᴘ!
all_reviews.text: It's great, the enhancing got better by recent updates, but the only thing that I don't like about it is after enhancing a picture, the colour differs from the original. The contrast increases, the picture becomes yellowish, which by the way I don't like. It should just stick to the original colour after enhancing and not change that.

all_reviews.author: ex9ctly!

The app's features are good but the ads are just too disruptive. I've been trying to enhance 1 photo for more or less 30 minutes now.

all_reviews.author: Stevie Haga
all_reviews.text: I've been using this app for a long time, but recently the adds have gotten horrendous, I can't touch anything without one popping up. I'm truly disappointed, and I know the excuse that because of the adds the company can keep it "free," but that's a load of bull in my opinion. They make money, and we have a horrible experience. Mhm, makes sense.

all_reviews.author: NotRusky

all_reviews.author: Danielle Palmer

all_reviews.author: Ais R

Don't waste your money on the non-free version. I regret my purchase.

all_reviews.author: Frankie Andrews

all_reviews.author: Leigh Terry

all_reviews.author: Jefferson Taylor

In my opinion, this app is a complete waste of time and data. I strongly recommend not downloading it.

I used this for so long but literally, out of nowhere, the ads aren't playing anymore and I can't enhance any picture. If I reinstall the app, the ads reappear but only for one time and then when it enhances the picture, I can't save it because there's no ads playing again. Now when I click "enhance" the app just kicks me out.

all_reviews.author: Robert Jones
all_reviews.text: I am a paid subscriber to this app and I have to say this is the best colorizer available that I have found and I have used about 12 other ones. The features included (even the free version with ads) are really very good. I do a lot of photo editing , especially old nostalgia type colour conversions and the results are very impressive. You wont find a better colorizer anywhere in my opinion. I use it on my phone and also on my Windows PC by installing the programme on Bluestacks which is a really good Android emulator. If you have used Bluestacks before and stopped using it, well worth a revisit. I would certainly recommend Remini highly...................... UPDATE!!!! A lot of the above review is no longer relevant, all we have now is unblur which can be overdone very easily leaving some very scary faces. There are countless other alternatives to do the colouring part but it would be better and less expensive to have it all in one place and on one app. It would also help if it were possible to be able to adjust the sharpening/enhancement with a slider. The face enhancement should include all of the hair not half of it sometimes. Very hard to fix the hair after enhancement. I do a lot of old black and white photographs. I often find it a better colourising output if I soften the face after sharpening slightly to take out the harsh with a liquidise sharpening reduction with PS or Gimp. Complete garments need to be recognised better to reduce the multi colour effects on them.

Please check you internet connection and try again later.". My app is up to date and so as my phone software. I am paying a weekly subscription and now I am unable to use this. I contacted thee help center and they have not responded except for they don't know what's wrong. I will need a refund.

I downloaded this app hoping for a simple photo enhancer, but be cautious! I thought I was signing up for a $1 weekly subscription, only to be charged $9.99 instead. It's frustrating, especially when canceling the subscription is made unnecessarily difficult (you have to do it through the website). Make sure you read the fine print carefully!

I cancelled the subscription after the introductory pricing of a dollar or so (week 2) and it continued to charge me full price for a couple of months with nowhere to get a refund! To make it worse, they charge WEEKLY. On top of that, the app only works half the time, takes forever to generate, and never let me use any of the premium features. DO NOT DOWNLOAD.

It is very good but it works out very expensive I'm sure it would sell much better if the price was more reasonable like £10 a month instead of £10 a week, the price is a bit frightening enough to put me off. Works better on old B&W photos than old colour photos. I can't give 5 stars only because of price. Paint shop and Photo shop (expenive one buy) works out cheaper but more tricky and you need a PC. It's less time consuming than the computer software available.

Edit: I went to cancel and the language on the cancel subscription screen is VERY misleading and I have picture and video. That took my rating from a 4 to a 1. Remove that ASAP! You shouldn't have to trick people into paying for your app! After hitting "cancel subscription" a screen pops up that offers a paid version or an option to "go back to limited" and there is a "continue" button. I hit continue to complete the cancelation and instead it locked me in to pay for a week THEN cancel!

It's a decent photo enhancer, but nothing special. You only get to enhance 5 photos a day unless you get their pro subscription, which sucks because I'm a photographer/artist and it would be nice if it didn't take 6 days to enhance all of my photos. Plus, the enhancer itself is really wonky; most of the time it just weirdly smooths everything out, putting many things into the uncanny valley. Overall, it's an okay app. Nothing great, but it's not bad.

The paint feature is good for the most part, it messes up people's faces sometimes, I wish there was a way to tweak it a bit. But I'm only putting 3 stars because you only get 5 images free per day and you have to watch a 30 sec ad for each one, and then it still says 70 tasks ahead of yours! Please give more free ones (Im happy to watch an ad each time but let me do more a day!) or reduce the monthly subscription because I can't afford it!

I am a paid subscriber to this app and I have to say this is the best colorizer available that I have found and I have used about 12 other ones. The features included (even the free version with ads) are really very good. I do a lot of photo editing , especially old nostalgia type colour conversions and the results are very impressive. You wont find a better colorizer anywhere in my opinion. I use it on my phone and also on my Windows PC by installing the programme on Bluestacks which is a really good Android emulator. If you have used Bluestacks before and stopped using it, well worth a revisit. I would certainly recommend Remini highly...................... UPDATE!!!! A lot of the above review is no longer relevant, all we have now is unblur which can be overdone very easily leaving some very scary faces. There are countless other alternatives to do the colouring part but it would be better and less expensive to have it all in one place and on one app. It would also help if it were possible to be able to adjust the sharpening/enhancement with a slider. The face enhancement should include all of the hair not half of it sometimes. Very hard to fix the hair after enhancement. I do a lot of old black and white photographs. I often find it a better colourising output if I soften the face after sharpening slightly to take out the harsh with a liquidise sharpening reduction with PS or Gimp. Complete garments need to be recognised better to reduce the multi colour effects on them.

I often find it a better colourising output if I soften the face after sharpening slightly to take out the harsh with a liquidise sharpening reduction with PS or Gimp. Complete garments need to be recognised better to reduce the multi colour effects on them.

Awesome way to clear up old photos or blurry photos of faces. I was impressed. However my needs are more along the lines of blurry nature photos of animals. My spouse has lits of old family pictures that it has been great for. It would be worth it for the yearly price if you wanted great facial images of your old photos. The ads on the free version are long and cringy lol. Overall I was impressed. Would pay yearly if I personally needed it.

new filters / styles.text: Remini, what are you doing? The more I use it, the worse the results get. It ruins the photos so much. The old version was amazing, clean, clear, didn't change the colors, and had various filter options. Now they're gone?! I tried it again earlier and the original photo became ugly and messed up. Please fix it, and also, please keep the original colors because that's what I want.

I give 3 stars because I much like the old remini than the updated one. I don't like the updated remini because its change the appearance of the picture specially on filter it's more like warm tone and more brightness that's why I'm not satisfied for the outcome. Also on saving picture after the enchantment. I can't save my pics because I reach the limit? Though I didn't use remini all the time. Please bring back the old style of remini just focus on enchancing the picture thank you.

This app is good but,I don't really like it cuz it just highlighting your image and adds a little few more pixels, it makes you to look fair in the edited one it's good to see but it's looking like graphic or something it's not so realistic to be honest it's like AniMe!!!And it asks for ad before every photo were gonna edit My suggestion is please don't highlight the photo,Just add more pixels when you edit this it looks like using a filter!

cancel in-progress processing.text: I'd be lying if i said this app wasn't cool...But, It takes a long time to generate, which is not a problem, I should be able to cancel the generator or at least be asked if I'm sure I want to generate the picture, once you generate you have to wait the time it gives you which can be 5-10 minutes or more. Over all, it generates very accurate and well, it can sometimes give you three arms and 6 legs lol, It's a really fun app. It just has a few things that could be fix.

language support.text: Edit: I went to cancel and the language on the cancel subscription screen is VERY misleading and I have picture and video. That took my rating from a 4 to a 1. Remove that ASAP! You shouldn't have to trick people into paying for your app! After hitting "cancel subscription" a screen pops up that offers a paid version or an option to "go back to limited" and there is a "continue" button. I hit continue to complete the cancelation and instead it locked me in to pay for a week THEN cancel!

undo / redo.text: Too many ads that weren't there before. I also do not like the automatic face enhancer at all. I wouldn't mind it if it had an option to undo it, but it doesn't. There should be an option for that. Not everyone wants their face enhanced.

batch / bulk / queue processing.text: Expensive, but it does what it says it will. In my case it didn't work as dramaticly as advertised, but it made a difference. My issue with it is the cost. At $2.99/week, it is designed for the professional photographer, not for keeping around to fix the occasional family photo. I would love it if they offered a reasonable free w/ads or single use option that didn't automatically renew. I can see signing in and paying for week every once in awhile to handle a batch of family photos.

I decided to go ahead and buy Remini as I wanted to enhance more than 5 photos per day (I have a ton of old photos that are scratched, etc). Unfortunately, once you pay for it, you suddenly get weird delays. "22,955 requests ahead, your task will be ready in a few minutes". I'm paying for this, why is there now a queue when there wasn't before? Yet, when I use the free version on my hubby's phone (just tested), I waited 30 seconds for the same thing! Don't waste your money on the non-free version. I regret my purchase.

Amazing experience using it. Have enhanced at least 300+ photos by now! One major suggestion though. A "render queue" feature would be very very useful if you want to do a lot of images at once. Its very tiresome for me to process the photos one by one while having to wait for the initianalization process. If you could add the queue feature it would be great. I'd pay for it tbh

background / full-photo enhancement.text: It did make my photos less blurry, the big down side for me though is that it made the faces look terrifying when they were further away. I tried on a couple different photos, the close ups worked but I tried putting one up for my profile pic and it just blurred back up when I posted it. This app would be good for unblurring backgrounds but not people in my experience.

Has extra charges for services that you'd assume was included in this app for the price they charge. I figured when I purchased the product that meant unlimited pro, but it doesn't and they want you to pay extra for something that could be easily done for free on Adobe Lightroom or Google Snapseed! The recolorize is actually good but their normal enhance and enhance+ only targets and clears the face leaving the picture looking weird with the same blurred original background. Needs improvement!

Really love the app, and I only had it for one day! Sure, the images don't look PERFECT, but they look good enough. They end up a little distorted but it's ok. The backgrounds don't look very good but i don't care much about background, just the main thing in the picture. I downloaded this app to make a picture I have made into a poster but the picture was really blurry. Now, other than background distortions, it looks fine. Wish you didn't have to watch adds for almost every action, though.

Was nice when it worked. I used it about ten times total, then suddenly it quit working. App would load up, pics and all, but when I click on a pic, it just said skip after 5 secs then goes back to my pics, not enhancing nothing no matter what pic I choose from folders I'm enhancing. It's up to date and all so dunno.. also it would be nice if it enhanced the entire picture instead of just a face, there's no sense of having a clear face on a blurry body/background LOL

The app is good, it unblurs and enhances pictures. However, when I want to disable the other options such as colors, background enhancer, and etc. it won't let me disable it for free. I need to purchase their pro plan first before I can use it but my cousin's remini let's her app use it for free. I hope this issue will be fixed, thanks!

I can actually see my great-grandfather instead of a blurry old photo. I wish it could enhance the rest of the photo, not just the face. The color feature needs a lot of improvement. It just turns sections of the picture orange and that's it. Also, I wish there was a no eyelashes option. It keeps giving people thick full eyelashes where there aren't any.

export / original quality.text: One great app I have come across. I like the features in it, just that most of the features are kept for pro users. For the AI photo generation, please let the body of the pictures be maintained just like the face, not turning a fat person to become slim. Please work on maintaining the size and height of the person and add more models to it especially some with traditional attire and please since we are using it on the paid version, remove the watermark that's attached to the generated image.

delete my data / uploaded photos.text: There is no delete option of upload image and enhanced images... which is very bad for privacy. To the devoloper - please add the delete key
